fact: The Universite de Diffa was selected through a competitive process to host a UNIPOD innovation hub, and a workshop validating its project document opened on 20 August 2026 under the AfDB- and UNDP-backed PIDAJ programme, with construction still to come.

The University of Dosso on 14 August 2026 called for applications to the first cohort of projects to incubate at UNIPOD Niger, a UNDP-supported innovation centre whose construction and equipment are done, offering coworking, mentoring and prototyping support.

Numéricité names the Centre Incubateur des Petites et Moyennes Entreprises (CIPMEN) as an incubator of technology startups in Niger that has regularly produced promising solutions, with no programme or cohort described.
